opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Category maxima: New Projects and Commissions £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications £5,000; Long-Term Research £20,000; Research and Travel £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating non-profit for at least 12 months) for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, and Long-Term Research. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for Research and Travel grants. Not for individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding appreciation of sculpture. Categories cover exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing, display, conferences, lectures, non-commercial publications, and long-term research. Applications considered four times per year; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation: UK up to £600; Europe up to £700; Rest of world up to £1,000, plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers interested in Henry Moore specifically (Studios & Gardens fellowships); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for longer six-week Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships allowing researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute facilities in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence. Applications currently closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.
